theme: What a request wants: HTTP methods, GET requests and POST requests

terms.definition: A word in a request, like GET or POST, that tells the server what to do.
terms.example: Change the HTTP method to DELETE.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com")!
var r = URLRequest(url: u)
r.httpMethod = "DELETE"
print(r.httpMethod!)

terms.definition: A request that asks the server to send data without changing anything.
terms.example: A GET request loads the profile.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com/users")!
let r = URLRequest(url: u)
print(r.httpMethod!)  // default

terms.definition: A request that sends new data to the server, for example to create an account.
terms.example: Send a POST request to create the order.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com/users")!
var r = URLRequest(url: u)
r.httpMethod = "POST"
r.httpBody = Data("name=Ann".utf8)
print(r.httpBody!.count)

video.title: HTTP Method, GET Request & POST Request | Day 202
video.description:
Learn to explain reading and creating data with requests: HTTP Method, GET Request & POST Request, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
HTTP Method - A word in a request, like GET or POST, that tells the server what to do.
GET Request - A request that asks the server to send data without changing anything.
POST Request - A request that sends new data to the server, for example to create an account.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain HTTP Method, GET Request & POST Request in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
HTTP Method, GET Request, POST Request 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

HTTP Method - A word in a request, like GET or POST, that tells the server what to do.
한국어: HTTP Method: GET이나 POST처럼 서버가 무엇을 해야 하는지 알려 주는 요청 속 단어

GET Request - A request that asks the server to send data without changing anything.
한국어: GET Request: 아무것도 바꾸지 않고 서버에 데이터를 보내 달라고 하는 요청

POST Request - A request that sends new data to the server, for example to create an account.
한국어: POST Request: 계정을 만들 때처럼 새 데이터를 서버에 보내는 요청

landscape.hook: Can you explain HTTP Method, GET Request and POST Request in English?

dialogue.title: Sending a new user

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need to send a new user to the server. What do I change in the request?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set the HTTP method. It is a word like GET or POST that tells the server what to do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which HTTP method is the default?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: GET. A GET request asks the server for data and changes nothing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a GET request is safe to repeat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, you can send a GET request many times.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a POST request. It sends new data to the server, like in our code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where do I put the user data?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In `httpBody` of the POST request. Set `httpMethod` to POST first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. GET to read, POST to create.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The HTTP method matters a lot to the server.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com/users")!
var r = URLRequest(url: u)
r.httpMethod = "POST"
r.httpBody = Data("name=Ann".utf8)
